overrides.help.guide.failure.body: Check the address, gateway, server availability and authentication details. Retry is explicit. Use Disconnect or Cancel to stop the current attempt; exiting the app closes its connections.
overrides.help.guide.listen.body: File > Listen for connections opens a listener. Give the server this PC’s network address and the displayed listening port, then accept or reject the incoming request. The first time you listen, Windows Firewall may ask whether TidyVNC can accept connections. Closing the listener stops waiting for new connections.

windowsOnly.help.guide.install.title: Installing and removing
windowsOnly.help.guide.install.body: TidyVNC installs for your Windows account only, in your local app data folder, without administrator rights. Installers are not yet code-signed: when you open a downloaded installer, Windows SmartScreen may say it protected your PC; choose More info, then Run anyway, if the installer came from the TidyVNC project. Where Smart App Control is on, Windows blocks unsigned apps, so TidyVNC cannot run there until it is signed. Uninstalling from Settings > Apps keeps your settings, profiles, history and trust decisions in %LOCALAPPDATA%\TidyVNC and saved passwords in Credential Manager; delete that folder and the TidyVNC entries in Credential Manager to remove them.
windowsOnly.app.windows.11.required: This version of TidyVNC requires Windows 11. On earlier versions of Windows, use the classic TidyVNC viewer (vncviewer) instead.
windowsOnly.tunnel.error.windows.client.missing: The Windows OpenSSH Client is not installed. Add it in Settings > System > Optional features, then connect again.
windowsOnly.profiles.ssh.windows.client.missing: Install the OpenSSH Client in Settings > System > Optional features to use an SSH gateway.

windowsOnly.listener.firewall.title: Windows Firewall
windowsOnly.listener.firewall.message: Windows Defender Firewall may ask whether TidyVNC can accept connections on private or public networks. If a server cannot reach this computer, allow TidyVNC in Windows Security > Firewall & network protection > Allow an app through firewall. TidyVNC does not change firewall rules itself.
